correctness.rationale: From the six cyclic tetrahedron generators there are 90 tetrahedra, 180 triangles, all 105 edges and 15 vertices. Independent full GF(2) elimination gave rank ∂2=88, rank ∂3=89, hence dim H2=3. The independent exhaustive computation checked every vertex subset of size ≤7: none of cardinality ≤6 supports nonzero ambient H2, exactly 60 of cardinality 7 do; all sixty induced surfaces have (7,21,14), no tetrahedra, each edge in exactly two triangles and orientable torus links. Four homology quotient vectors each occur 15 times, with independent basis representatives and affine translations acting transitively; no infinite extrapolation was involved.
